title: Symbiosis-Edge: Cost-Aware Drift Adaptation with Edge Models, LLM Oracles, and Human Experts
description: Research software for evaluating cost-aware supervision routing under concept drift with edge models, LLM oracles, and human experts.
references: Jorge Martinez-Gil, Florian Bachinger, Rudolf Ramler, Francois Picard, Leïla Belmerhnia, Georgios Spathoulas: Drift Adaptation as Supervision Routing under Heterogeneous Costs. DEXA 2026, pp. 49-63, Springer.
